accepted_decisions: Sonnet 5 (claude-cli, no API key) is the app runtime generator — chosen for auth/ops (decision_registry entry 7). VALIDATED this session via the dialectic-smoke runtime check.
Structured non-determinism: a tension-sharpened softmax sampled with an injected RNG (bifurcation), not unconstrained randomness — the probabilities evolve, not the seed.
Synthesis = reconciliation (min-sim to both poles), not the geometrically impossible 'far from both yet explains both'.
Tension is symmetric, so it modulates tau / prosody / synthesis-gate / prompts — never a scoring term.
Two clocks combine only inside DialecticalField.target(); SpectralGloss is wind, not a steering wheel.
fieldEnergy: commit the priors (FIELD_V2.md), defer implementation.

Waking mode is a distinct register: waking role prompts + waking system prompt + waking prosody, selected for the three waking profiles.
